title: Claude Code
system: Claude Code, through the Lathe plugin (its MCP server over stdio and its hooks), and the user's own claude CLI the desktop app's chat runs headless
description: The Agent's MCP client and the plugin's host: the plugin's MCP tools are one per aggregate command and query, and its guard hook answers Claude Code's PreToolUse calls. The desktop app's chat (LA-PLT-UC19) runs the user's own claude CLI headless with stream-json input and output, answers its permission prompts, and gives it the window's app bridge, which the MCP server's app_focus and app_open tools reach.

title: File manager
system: The operating system's file manager (Finder on macOS) and clipboard
description: The desktop app hands it the data file that holds a record, to reveal in its folder, and puts the record's ID on the clipboard, from the record's menu or its own action.

title: Code editor
system: VS Code by default; Cursor, Zed, the system's default app or a command of the Owner's own
description: The desktop app hands it the data file that holds a record to open, by the editor's macOS app, its command, the system's default app or the Owner's own command with the file as its last argument; nothing comes back.

title: Git
description: The product folder's git repository, from which a record's history is read, never written.

title: Browser history
description: The window's history, `window.history`: the app pushes and replaces its entries, notes where a page was in an entry's state, and steps back and forward through it.

title: System browser
description: Where a link to another site opens, outside the app.

title: Electron
system: The Electron runtime the desktop shell runs in
description: In development the watcher starts Electron on the shell's last build, and restarts it when the main process or a preload changes; a build that fails leaves it running.

title: electron-builder
system: electron-builder, which packs the desktop app
description: Packs the built shell and the staged Lathe package into an unsigned macOS app for this Mac's architecture in desktop/release/, which git ignores; it signs, notarizes and publishes nothing.

title: Git merge driver
system: git's merge driver: the `merge.lathe-data` driver a product repo's git config names, run for each data file its .gitattributes marks
description: Git runs `lathe merge-data %O %A %B %P` for each data file a merge changes on both sides: Lathe merges the three versions row by row and writes the result over ours, or exits 1 naming each clash. Nothing in Lathe calls git for it.

title: On-device speech recognition
system: NVIDIA's Parakeet Unified 0.6B speech model, run by FluidAudio with Core ML on the Mac (its weights fetched once from Hugging Face); macOS's SpeechAnalyzer and SpeechTranscriber (macOS 26 and later) when that model cannot be loaded; and the microphone
description: The desktop app hears the microphone and has the Mac itself recognize the words, with their times, beside where the voice starts and stops and how its pitch moves; no audio leaves the Mac, and nothing is recorded or saved. Only the model's weights are fetched, once.
